newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end weak, more downside seen.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end weak, more downside seen.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures continued their recent decline on Thursday, finishing uncomfortably close to the 20,500-points psychological support level.

Dealers said the market could head lower in the short term, and strong buying interest was unlikely to surface much above the 20,000 base although some support is seen at 20,310 and 20,100, basis the December contract.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 December contract ended 80 points above its intra-day low of 20,460 against a previous settlement at 20,675.

"We're starting to see some reasonably large selling coming in but I think we're getting near the bottom," said a trader with a European institution, adding that the market had bounced back from just below the 20,000 level twice this year.
"Money will have to go into the equity market given the yields on JGBs," he added.
Dealers said the market was likely to receive a boost on Friday from news that parties in the outgoing Japanese coalition had formed a loose alliance and agreed on a policy platform.
